# Oleksandr Yukhno

> 30+ years across electronics, software, project delivery and retail operations. Former CTO at Ciklum and Director of the IT office and the project management office at Silpo, one of Ukraine's largest food retail chains (about 120 → 300 stores, around 40,000 people during my years). Today a partner at FlipManager, an AI-products startup, building AI assistants and an AI-run project office. Interested in projects and roles in AI adoption, operational transformation and building a next-generation PMO, where I own the result.

Online CV in English and Ukrainian. Contact via LinkedIn only.

## Projects

- [Autosound Tuning Skill](https://github.com/ayukhno/autosound-tuning-skill): a deterministic seven-phase process for car-audio DSP tuning, with AI flexible at every step
- [Autosound TCC](https://github.com/ayukhno/autosound-tcc): multilingual desktop app for macOS and Windows on top of the skill
- [This website](https://github.com/ayukhno/ayukhno.github.io): an idea on Wednesday, a Codex prototype, then eight hours with Claude and Gemini to a proofread site online, about $40 of AI usage
